# penpot-mpl — code ported from Penpot (MPL-2.0)

Every file in this folder is a close translation of Penpot source and stays under the
Mozilla Public License 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). Keep the MPL header and the
"Ported from" line in each file. Changes to these files stay MPL and must be shared on request.
Our own code that only calls these files (e.g. `../core/whiteboard-snap.ts`) is not MPL.

Source: https://github.com/penpot/penpot at commit `e20a0d7`. Copyright (c) KALEIDOS SUBSIDIARY SL.
